requests.title: Requests

latency.title: Latency
latency.empty: No latency data was recorded in the selected range.

statusCodes.title: Status codes

emptyState.defaultDescription: Nothing was recorded in the selected range.
emptyState.hintPumpDown: Tyk Pump is not running or cannot be reached, so new requests are not being recorded. Start the tyk-pump service.
emptyState.hintTablesMissing: Tyk Pump has not created its analytics tables yet. Make sure the tyk-pump service is running.
emptyState.hintNoTraffic: The analytics tables exist but no requests have been recorded yet. Send traffic through the gateway to populate them.

staleNotice.title: Tyk Pump is not running
staleNotice.description: New requests are not being recorded, so the figures below are stale. Last record: {lastRecord}. Start the tyk-pump service to resume.

auditLogs.title: Audit Logs
auditLogs.subtitle: Track all actions and changes across your platform.
auditLogs.exportHint: Exports up to 10,000 entries for the selected date range; the resource and action filters are not applied.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.subtitle: Filter live gateway traffic by API, key, method, status, path and latency.

filters.title: Traffic filters
filters.active: {count, plural, one {# filter} other {# filters}} active

endpoints.topDescription: Most requested method and path pairs
endpoints.slowDescription: Highest P95 among the busiest, with at least 5 requests

search.title: Request search
search.description: Find captured requests and responses by status, latency, headers or the words in their bodies.
search.syntaxHint: Type a filter and press Enter: status:>=500, method:POST, latency:>800, path:/orders, api:name, key:name, reqh:name=value, resh:name, body:"two words", req:word, res:word. A leading - excludes.
search.notIndexedYet: The search index has not started yet. Captured requests appear here shortly after they are recorded.
search.coverage: Word search covers the first 16 KiB of each body.
search.emptyNoCapture: No captured requests in this window. Turn on detailed recording for an API to capture them.
search.emptyNoMatch: No captured request matches these filters in this window.
search.truncatedHint: Only the first 16 KiB of a body is kept and searched.

errors.tooLong: That value is longer than {max} characters.
errors.method: Methods look like GET or POST,PUT.
errors.headerName: Header names use letters, digits and dashes.
errors.termTooShort: Use at least {min} letters or digits: a shorter term matches too much.
errors.commonWord: "{term}" appears in almost every request; search for something more specific.
errors.tooManyBodyClauses: At most 3 body-word filters per search.

apiErrors.tooBroad: That search is too broad to finish in time. Add a status, an API or a shorter window, or use a more specific word.
apiErrors.busy: Another search is still running. Wait a moment and try again.
apiErrors.invalid: The server did not understand one of the filters.
apiErrors.forbidden: You do not have access to search captured requests.

detail.redactionNote: Secrets are hidden by name before anything is stored or searched. Bodies are cut at 16 KiB.
detail.loadError: The request could not be loaded.
